title: George Hunt Williamson as Adamski's handler and Silver Shirts editor

tellings.quote: Now, let's look at uh George Hunt Williamson. So, George Hunt Williamson was um uh it was a pseudonym.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast, says that George Hunt Williamson, a man linked to George Adamski, who claimed in the 1950s to have met visitors from space, was using a false name. Jorjani presents Williamson as Adamski's handler and ties him to the Silver Shirts, an American far-right group led by William Dudley Pelley, as an editor of a publication called Valor, and he also points to a book called Closer Encounters. If true, it would mean someone was steering early alien contact stories from behind the scenes.
